Prior formalities with CIL before processing; regulated cross-border transfers (contract with foreign recipient with data-return clause, encryption); fuller right to information; health data hosted in Burkina Faso unless CIL exempts

Law No. 2013-015 of 21 May 2013 on the Protection of Personal Data in the Republic of Mali (amended by Law No. 2017-070 of 18 December 2017)
State, local authorities, public bodies, and private natural and legal persons processing data wholly or partly in Mali

Free right of access; rights to correct, update, block or delete inaccurate or unlawfully kept data; objection right including before first use for third-party prospecting; controller responds within 30 days; APDP approves transfers

APDP: warnings, formal notices, injunctions, withdrawal of approval; courts: fines of about CFA 2.5 million to 20 million plus imprisonment; obstructing APDP inspections CFA 5 million to 20 million (art. 65(7) as amended). 2025 fine of CFA 5 million on a clinic for undeclared CCTV
Purely personal or domestic activity, unless data are systematically shared with third parties for dissemination
